title: Statistical delocalization in the Anyonic Aubry-André model
summary: Many-body localization is remarkable in that localization persists despite the presence of dynamical interactions. Here we demonstrate the converse phenomenon: enhanced many-body delocalization induced solely by exchange statistics. We study a Aubry-André quasiperiodic system of anyons in one dimension in the absence of density-density interactions. In terms of anyon operators, the system is described by a quadratic Hamiltonian.
